description: This file defines classes and structures related to MPEG tables, specifically Program Association Table (PAT) and Program Map Table (PMT), used in broadcast MPEG streams. It includes class definitions, iterators, and methods for parsing MPEG section data.

classes.name: PAT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Association Table with methods to access transport stream ID and program list.

classes.name: ProgramIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing programs within a PAT.

classes.name: PMT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Map Table with methods to access program details and streams.

classes.name: StreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing streams within a PMT.

methods.name: TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the PAT.

methods.name: Programs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the programs in the PAT.

methods.name: ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number from the program info.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID associated with a program.

methods.name: Streams
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the streams in the PMT.

methods.name: StreamType
methods.description: Returns the stream type of a stream in the PMT.

methods.name: Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors associated with a stream.

methods.name: ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number of the PMT.

methods.name: PCRPid
methods.description: Returns the PCR PID from the PMT.
